I am an old man of 80 years in the North East, and my strength is not what it was. This land has been in my hands a long time, and I grow my beans together with other crops as my fathers did. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer, and the rains here must do the watering — there is no irrigation on my plot. My sons and their wives help me with the work, and when the weeding is heavy I call a few hands from the village to assist.
